title: Madrid Residency Night 4 — Spanish Cinema Takes La Casita; 256,000+ Fans Through Four Sold-Out Shows
detail: Bad Bunny performed Night 4 of his landmark 10-night residency at Riyadh Air Metropolitano in Madrid on June 3, 2026, again before a sold-out crowd of approximately 64,000, completing the second back-to-back cluster (June 2–3) of the engagement. Through four nights, the residency has now drawn more than 256,000 fans — well on pace toward the projected 640,000 total across all 10 shows, which would mark the largest single-artist concert run in Spanish history. Night 4 broke from the pattern of musical surprise guests — the three prior nights had each featured an exclusive performer: Myke Towers (Night 1), Luar La L (Night 2), and Young Miko (Night 3) — and instead delivered an exceptionally starry night of Spanish film and cultural celebrity in La Casita, the secondary elevated platform at center stage. Among the VIP guests in La Casita were acclaimed actress Penélope Cruz (attending for the second time, having previously visited during the Puerto Rico residency in August 2025), her sister and dancer Mónica Cruz, celebrated Spanish actors Luis Tosar and Óscar Jaenada, actress Goya Toledo, and rising urban artists Saiko and Trueno. Spanish media headlined it 'el cine español toma La Casita de Bad Bunny.' The night featured two unique setlist additions distinguishing it from the standard DtMF show: 'Como antes' — a deep cut from his 2018 debut album *X 100PRE* — and 'Moscow Mule' from *Un Verano Sin Ti*, both greeted with massive crowd recognition. Following Night 4, the residency enters a three-day rest period (June 4–5) before the third cluster begins on June 6.
